data.raw_text: Bit of history. Kahane's Jewish supremacist rhetoric and terrorism led to his assassination by one El Sayid Nossair at an extremist meeting Kahane addressed in midtown Manhattan. The sentencing of Nossair inspired a pipe bombing plot against the judge by a rag-tag crew of Muslim extremists. Telephone traffic between one of the conspirators and Baghdad led to Saddam Hussein's intelligence service dispatching Abdul Basit Karim (aka "Ramzi Yousef") to New York to transform the small-scale plot into a major attack on the World Trade Center on the second anniversary of Kuwait's liberation from Iraqi occupation. Yousef, a UK-educated Kuwaiti guest worker, was later identified as a collaborator with Iraqi invaders by Kuwait's Interior Minister -- keen on pyrotechnics since his youth, he was said to have been involved in the torching of Kuwait's oilfields as Saddam's forces retreated from the Emirate. He also appears to have apprenticed with Ihsan Barbouti, a London-based Iraqi arms dealer and "fixer" implicated in Col. Ghaddafi's bombing of Pan Am Flight 101 and in a scheme to mass-produce cyanide at a plant he acquired in Boca Raton, FL.  Yousef later set up shop with his maternal uncle, Khalid Sheikh Mohammed (KSM), running terror plots out of Cebu City in the Philippines. The two "entrepreneurs of terror" (as they are described in the 9/11 Commission Report) recruited individual Muslim militants and worked with larger outfits like the Abu Sayyaf Group and Osama bin Laden's Al-Qaeda during the 1990s. Their magnum opus was going to be Operation Bojinka, which was supposed to blow up a dozen US-bound trans-Pacific airliners in flight. A second arm of Bojinka included crashing a light plane filled with explosives into the CIA HQ in Langley, presumably in retaliation for Bill Clinton's cruise missile strike against the al-Mukhabarat HQ in Baghdad, a sub rosa retaliation for the TRADEBOMB attack. Ramzi Yousef was apprehended and convicted in New York under his nom de guerre. His uncle, KSM, remained at large (although under sealed indictment) and, working with Osama bin Laden's group, made good on the promise of Bojinka by toppling the World Trade Center towers and ramming a hijacked jumbo jet into the Pentagon on September 11, 2001.
